title: visual-clipper reframe plan
description: The camera plan Claude writes after watching a clip's frames. Crop-window keyframes that reframe_render.py slides over the landscape source to produce a moving 9:16 vertical short.

rationale.description: one line: why these camera moves serve this clip

keyframes.description: Ordered by t. Each is the crop-window center+zoom at a moment, t in CLIP-LOCAL seconds (0 = clip start). Hold a value by repeating it at two times; move by changing it between two times.

cx.description: crop-window center X as fraction of source width (0=left, 1=right)

cy.description: crop-window center Y as fraction of source height (0=top, 1=bottom)

zoom.description: 1.0 = widest 9:16 crop that fits; >1 punches in tighter

note.description: optional: what's happening here (e.g. 'punch in on emphasis')

examples.rationale: Speaker is camera-left through the setup, gestures center on the payoff line; punch in to sell the reveal.

keyframes.note: punch in on the key line
pull back to land the reveal
